name: Building AI into Practice Management and EHR Workflows
description: Follow one fictional 16-provider group practice through a year of AI projects: connect vendors to the PM and EHR without shared logins, score a voice agent's call log, test referral-fax extraction, bake off ambient scribes, catch E/M drift before a payer does, and tell the partners what the program really returned. Every exercise uses synthetic data.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Health and Life Sciences

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Building AI into Practice Management and EHR Workflows

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 18 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits

alignment.targetName: Evaluate how an AI tool should connect to a practice's PM and EHR given what it must read and write, and specify least-privilege scopes, an attributable service account, audit logging and business associate terms

alignment.targetName: Evaluate whether an AI patient-access agent is ready to go live and to place outbound calls, against gates set in advance and scored by caller language, with each call type's TCPA consent basis set by its purpose

alignment.targetName: Build and test a document-AI design for faxed referrals with source-page links, field-level accuracy, a patient-match gate, 42 CFR Part 2 routing and an exception queue sized to its staff

alignment.targetName: Analyze revenue-cycle AI output for integrity risk and evaluate the review gate and overpayment response each finding requires under that payer's rules
